Summary: The Wi-Fi dropped because the signal weakened and the router stopped responding, likely due to distance or interference.
likely_cause: Weak Wi-Fi signal and router unresponsiveness at the time of the drop.
Evidence: The Wi-Fi signal dropped from 4/5 to 1/5 at 8:17 AM, then router stopped answering.
Router didn't respond in 3 of 6 checks during the hour before the drop.
Event at 8:21:08 AM confirms disconnection due to signal loss.
No recent changes, updates, or driver issues were recorded.
Steps: Moved closer to the router to check if distance is affecting the signal.
Restarted the router to refresh the connection.
Checked if other devices on the same network also lost connection.
Tested the Wi-Fi signal strength using a phone or device nearby.
